channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Studio ALTA Residence 2027: four residency open calls (Prague)
    https://www.altart.cz/rezidence-2027/
    Studio ALTA · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Residency fees paid to participants: Research House CZK 12,000 per project; Rest House CZK 6,000 per person; House in the Neighborhood CZK 30,000 per project; House of Sweat CZK 15,000 per project. All include workspace at Studio ALTA; the two production residencies add dramaturgic, production, technical and PR support. Free to apply.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Research Trip to Switzerland
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/research-trip-to-switzerland/
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline Rolling / undated · Accommodation, travel costs, and daily allowances covered, plus a local coach (a cultural professional from the Swiss artistic field) to facilitate networking and exchange. Applicants with childcare responsibilities can request up to CHF 1,000 per month toward childcare or children's travel expenses. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Chornobyl40: Open Call 2026 (Virtual Residency & International Exhibition)
    https://forms.gle/5btrxy7LwfY8QyFW6
    Chornobyl40 (gate22 / European Institute of Chornobyl consortium) · deadline Closed 12 Jul 2026 · Residency is free to attend. For the 20 projects selected for production: EUR 500 grant for fully digital works or EUR 1,000 grant for installations requiring physical materials, plus inclusion in the international exhibition. Travel, accommodation, and transport are not covered. No application fee.
